title: Asymptotic lower bound on maximum influence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number such that $1<\log n$, $96(\log n)^{5/12}\le\sqrt{\log n}$, and $(\log n)/2\le\exp(\sqrt{\log n}/2)$. For every function $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, its maximum coordinate influence is at least $\frac12\operatorname{Var}(f)\frac{\log n}{n}\bigl(1-(\log n)^{-1/2}\bigr)$, where the variance and influences are taken with respect to the uniform sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to $\{−1,1\}$
